name: checkout
description: Switch to an existing branch, or with create true make a new one and switch to it. This moves between branches and nothing else: it will not restore or discard files, and it will not force a switch over uncommitted changes. Check what exists with git/branch first.

branch.description: The branch to switch to, or with create true the name of the branch to make.

create.description: Create the branch rather than expecting it to exist. Fails if a branch of that name is already there, which is deliberate: it means the name was not the one you thought.

start_point.description: Where a created branch starts, as a branch, tag or commit. Defaults to the current commit. Only valid with create true.

output_schema.description: One line: "on <branch>, was <branch>", or "already on <branch>" when the call changed nothing. Asking to switch to the branch already checked out is a success, so a flow that ensures it is on a branch does not have to check first.

exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, branch is missing, or start_point was given without create)
exit_codes.4: not permitted (the git repository is above the workspace root)
exit_codes.5: no repository (the workspace is not a git repository, or git is not installed)
exit_codes.6: refused (no such branch, the name is already taken, or the working tree has changes the switch would overwrite)
